description:
Update a Sentry Metric Monitor: its query, detection mode and conditions, name, owner, status, or connected Alerts. Omitted fields stay unchanged.
Read it with get_metric_monitor_details first. Alert notification actions change with update_alert_rule. Cron jobs: find_monitors. URL checks: find_uptime_monitors.

conditionGroup.description: Replaces all detection conditions; keep existing IDs. Static and Percent use threshold conditions, including a resolved one. Dynamic uses one anomaly_detection condition.

comparison.description: Threshold value. For Percent detection it is an absolute percentage of the earlier window: 110 means 10% higher.

config.description: Detection config fields to change. Static and Dynamic clear the comparison delta; a new detection type needs a matching condition group.

monitorId.description: Metric Monitor ID from find_metric_monitors, not a legacy metric alert ID.

organizationSlug.description: The organization slug, from `find_organizations`. In `org/project` notation, the part before the slash.

owner.description: Owner as user:<id> or team:<id>. Null clears it.

projectSlug.description: The project slug. In `org/project` notation, the part after the slash.

query.description: Query fields to change; omitted fields are kept and a null environment clears the filter. A new dataset needs a matching aggregate and eventTypes.

dataset.description: `metrics` is crash-free releases. `events_analytics_platform` covers spans, logs, and application metrics, chosen by eventTypes.

anyOf.description: The organization's region URL from `find_organizations`, e.g. `https://us.sentry.io`. Omit for self-hosted Sentry.

workflowIds.description: Alert workflow IDs to connect; replaces the current list. Copy IDs to keep from get_metric_monitor_details; [] disconnects all. The Alerts are not edited.

name: update_metric_monitor

conditionGroup.description: Native detection conditions, including resolution. Results: 75 critical, 50 warning, 0 resolved. Percent comparisons are absolute percentages (110 means 10% higher). Dynamic comparisons contain sensitivity, seasonality and thresholdType.

title: Update Metric Monitor
